name: stt
description: Transcribe an audio file (mp3, wav, m4a, flac, ogg, etc.) to text using FasterWhisper. Returns the transcript. Use for voice notes, meeting recordings, or any audio file (e.g. in inbox/).

path.description: Path to the audio file to transcribe.

model.description: Whisper model size: tiny, base, small, medium, large-v3. Default: base.

language.description: Optional 2-letter language code (e.g. 'en'). Auto-detected if omitted.
